Lucid Air Electric Drive Unit and Battery

When used with a 300 kW or higher charging station, the vehicle can gain 300 miles of range in 20 minutes.[44] The vehicle features a bidirectional rectifier capable of supplying up to 19.2 kW (240V ~ 80A) of AC power that could power a home or other load.[5]
The Air can be optioned as a dual-motor, all-wheel-drive powertrain producing up to 1,111 horsepower (828 kW) for the top of the range Air Dream Edition P.
